scope: First remote contact-repair attempt for the scissors-conditioned JoyAI video
summary: The repair stopped before frame zero because the transferred donor MP4 was truncated to 2.3 MB and lacked its moov atom. The incomplete run directory is retained and a new experiment uses a complete hash-verified remote donor.
evidence: FFmpeg reports 'moov atom not found' on the truncated remote donor.
The repair raises 'donor decoder ended before frame 0' and does not produce an accepted output.
The replacement donor is independently probed before the second run; the failed output directory is not reused.
lessons: Remote video inputs need size, hash, and ffprobe preflight before a multi-stream repair starts.
limitations: This record contains no quality result because processing did not begin.
next_actions: Preflight every remote donor with SHA-256 and ffprobe before starting repair.
